results.title: Seahawks Waive RB Kenny McIntosh
results.description: The Seahawks have waived running back Kenny McIntosh, per a team announcement. Brady Henderson of ESPN first reported the move. This continues a hard-luck 12 months for McIntosh, who suffered a torn ACL on July 26, 2025, and did not play at all during the Seahawks’ Super Bowl LX-winning season.
